'''Brak Sector News''' was a [[NewsNet]] devoted to reporting news from the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. It produced stories covering the riots in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Amma]] on [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]].
